paper_name: Priority Assignment for Global Fixed Priority Pre-emptive Scheduling in Multiprocessor Real-Time Systems
paper_description: Proves OPA applicable to global FP with three test conditions, shows high effectiveness with simple RTA test, and evaluates DM poor, DkC effective for priority assignment.

formal_description.statement: Optimal priority assignment policy P w.r.t. test S: maximizes tasksets schedulable by S.

informal_sketch.intuition: Best possible priorities for given test.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def optimal_policy(P, S):
    return max_schedulable(P, S) == max_possible(S)

formal_description.statement: OPA optimal for global FP if: 1) Monotonic in priority. 2) Independent of lower prios. 3) Schedulable at high => low.

informal_sketch.intuition: Audsley's algo works if test properties hold.
steps: Assign highest prio to task that can take it

formal_description.statement: Conditions 1-3 necessary for OPA to identify priorities correctly.

informal_sketch.intuition: Without them, OPA may miss feasible assignments.

formal_description.statement: Any exact schedulability test for periodic tasksets is OPA-incompatible.

informal_sketch.intuition: Exact tests depend on full ordering.
steps: Lower tasks affect higher in exact
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def incompatible_exact(S):
    return S.exact and not S.opa_compatible
